presetBranches.staticText: Head to the model bench in Room 103. You can build a rubber-band car or a two-story building with cross-bracing, one step at a time, then test it.

presetBranches.staticText: All four workshop rooms are open. Room 101 is the 3D Art Studio, Room 102 is the Science Lab, Room 103 is the Blueprint Lab and Room 104 is the World Builder Studio.
presetBranches.replySrc: 'All four workshop rooms are open. Room 101 is the 3D Art Studio, Room 102 is the Science Lab, Room 103 is the Blueprint Lab and Room 104 is the World Builder Studio.'

presetBranches.staticText: Room 104, the World Builder Studio, shows how a world like this campus gets made. Build a mini world on the layer table one layer at a time, from a sketch to a live website, then read the World Builder’s Handbook to start your own.
presetBranches.replySrc: 'Room 104, the World Builder Studio, shows how a world like this campus gets made. Build a mini world on the layer table one layer at a time, from a sketch to a live website, then read the World Builder’s Handbook to start your own.'

presetBranches.staticText: The Science Lab in Room 102 has three hands-on labs: a sieve analysis that measures the grain sizes in sand, an acid–base titration that finds the concentration of a mystery acid, and a pendulum that measures gravity.
presetBranches.replySrc: 'The Science Lab in Room 102 has three hands-on labs: a sieve analysis that measures the grain sizes in sand, an acid–base titration that finds the concentration of a mystery acid, and a pendulum that measures gravity.'

presetBranches.staticText: A blueprint is a technical drawing of a design, with every part labeled. In the Blueprint Lab, Room 103, tap any numbered part on a car, excavator, house, bridge or computer blueprint to learn its name, what it does and how you could build one.

presetBranches.staticText: In the 3D Art Studio, you draw in the air with brushes like Neon, Ribbon, Chrome and Rainbow, or stamp 3D shapes like stars, hearts and cubes. Turn on Mirror or ×6 to make symmetric art, spin it on the turntable, and switch to a blank canvas to work with nothing else around. It’s inspired by VR art apps like Tilt Brush, which XR Showcase featured.

presetBranches.staticText: Out in the Recess Yard, the balls, the foam-block tower and the soccer goal all run on real physics. At the soccer goal by the east fence, walk up to the ball and hold to power up (hold F, press and hold on the ball, or use the Kick button), look where you want it to go and let go. A keeper dives for it, and a goal earns the Striker badge. Walk into a ball to dribble it. You can push the swings and spin the merry-go-round too.
